The State   land measuring 337 kanals 06 marlas for the appellant-University  for establishment of its campus at Sungli, Tehsil Bhadarwah.

sentences.text: 4. We have heard learned counsel for the parties and carefully Signature Not Verified Digitally signed by SATISH KUMAR YADAV Date: 2024.12.11 19:26:47 IST  perused the record.

Reason:
 5.

It may be true that the appellant-University has not mentioned  2 the specific date when it came to know about the impugned Award etc. but keeping in view the fact that the delay was of 61 days only, the High Court ought to have adopted a liberal and pragmatic approach.
It was not a case where the rights stood fructified in such a manner that condoning of delay would lead to re-opening of the settled issues.
In a given case, the opposite party can be adequately compensated with costs also.

6. For the reasons aforestated, we allow this appeal; set aside the impugned order dated 02.03.2021 of the High Court; allowed the application of the appellant-University for condonation of delay of 61 days, subject to payment of cost of Rs.1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand) to each respondent.
7. Since the acquisition pertains to the year 2006-2007, we request the High Court to take up the First Appeal, preferred by the University, for early and out of turn adjudication.

8. It goes without saying that we have not expressed any opinion University Of Jammu vs Zamindarab Sungli on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56229314/
2 on the merits of the case.
